Fixtures for the history collectors (scripts/backfill_*.py, scripts/history_append.py,
scripts/reader_area_counts.py). The sandbox these were written in cannot reach USDA or NDMC,
so the shapes follow what the site's own readers have seen from those services
(scripts/fetch_transport.py, scripts/fetch_drought_county_week.py probe of 2026-10-16,
scripts/fetch_crop_progress.py, scripts/fetch_fert_ams.py fixtures). The numbers in them are
made up unless a file says it is a real answer. Nothing here is published.
